mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(uae.id) AS loginNum, TO_CHAR(uae.log_in_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS loginTime, ua.master_id AS masterId FROM gc_user_access_ext uae LEFT JOIN gc_user_access AS ua ON uae.user_access_id = ua.id LEFT JOIN gc_user AS u ON u.id = ua.user_id WHERE ua.user_id = ANY(#{userIds}) AND TO_CHAR(uae.log_in_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= #{startDate} AND TO_CHAR(uae.log_in_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= #{endDate} GROUP BY TO_CHAR(uae.log_in_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
select * from gc_user_access_ext where user_access_id = #{userAccessId} ORDER BY log_in_time desc limit 1

SELECT id, manager_id as managerId, COUNT(id) as adminLoginNum, TO_CHAR(log_in_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS loginTime FROM gc_user_access_ext WHERE manager_id = #{managerId} AND TO_CHAR(log_in_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= #{startDate} AND TO_CHAR(log_in_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= #{endDate} GROUP BY TO_CHAR(log_in_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD')

SELECT a.* FROM ( SELECT access.user_id, max(ext.id) AS extid, us.username, max(ext.log_in_time) AS log_in_time, info.first_name, info.last_name, EXTRACT(WEEK FROM age(NOW(), max(log_in_time))) AS weekNum, max(last_batchemail_time) AS emailTime FROM gc_user_access_ext ext LEFT JOIN gc_user_access access ON access.id = ext.user_access_id LEFT JOIN gc_user us ON us.id = access.user_id LEFT JOIN gc_user_info info ON info.id = us.info_id WHERE ext.user_access_id IS NOT NULL AND ext.manager_id IS NULL GROUP BY access.user_id ORDER BY user_id ASC ) a WHERE a.log_in_time < NOW() - '#{lastDaysScope} days'::interval AND (a.emailTime < NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days' OR a.emailTime IS NULL)
